title: fix(list): one 16px left edge on the list page, a 40px selection column at any width, no row numbers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEV9LRY8FfTWS7J6T3MwsSL)_
Fixes #35663

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb8qTxAVaE2QKwquQU

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：列表页左边对齐成一条线：页面栏图标、视图栏图标、表头和每行的勾选框、页脚条数都离左边 16；勾选列在列多要横向滚动时不再被挤到贴边，宽度始终一样；表格不再显示行号，勾选框不用悬停就看得见。
- 为什么做：属于列表页重做这一大项，解决维护者指出的「左侧一列没有对齐、左边距太小」和「行号没必要、勾选框应始终显示」。
- 出错会怎样：只改列表和各处表格的左侧排版与行号显示，不动数据和权限；关联列表、设计器里的表格也一并不再显示行号；「选项」里的行号开关和「已个性化」里的行号一项一起去掉；有问题可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

- **The selection column is 40px at any width** (`data-table.tsx`, `LEADING_CELL_WIDTH`). Every cell of the leading column (header, rows, summary row, the row-number-only cell) carries `w-[1%] min-w-10` instead of `w-10`. Under the table's automatic layout a plain `w-10` let the column shrink to its content once the columns overflowed (16px, the checkbox flush against the page), and on a table narrower than its box it took a share of the spare width (93.9px measured). `min-w-10` holds the floor; the 1% width makes it a percentage column, which auto layout sizes to its minimum and does not widen while a fixed or auto column can take the spare width (the same `1%` the `fitContent` columns use).
- **The checkbox sits 16px in** (`LEADING_CELL_INSET = 'pl-4 pr-2'`): 16 + 16 box + 8 gap = 40.
- **The checkbox is shown at rest.** The hover swap (`opacity-0` until hover / focus / coarse pointer / any selection) now applies only when a host opts into row numbers; without them every row's checkbox is visible.
- **`ObjectGrid` draws no row numbers unless its host asks** (`hostShowRowNumbers ?? false`, was `?? true`). Hosts whose grids lose their numbers with this: the related lists (`plugin-detail` `RelatedList`), the designers' grids (`plugin-designer` `ObjectManager`, `FieldDesigner`), `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` grid and any page block of type `object-grid`. None is kept on as an opt-in: after this PR no host passes the prop. `data-table`'s `showRowNumbers` stays as an opt-in for other hosts (it is a declared `DataTableSchema` key in `@object-ui/types`).
- **The view bar's ends** (`listToolbarRow.ts`, `TOOLBAR_ROW`): from `sm` up, `pl-2.5 pr-2` instead of `px-4`. Every item in the bar is a padded control, so the switcher's 6px-padded icon lands on 16, and the last text trigger's 8px-padded label ends 16 in, where the page bar's 「新建」 ends. Below `sm` the row is unchanged.
- **The list page stops passing row numbers, and the 行号 switch goes** (round 2, after #35646 merged). `ListView` drops its session-only row-number state, the `defaultRowNumbers` host prop and the `'rowNumbers'` personalization part; the console host's `defaultRowNumbers={!inSetup}` line goes (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx`); the switch leaves the Options menu's More level (`ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`, which now draws More only for how records open and Edit inline); the 「已个性化」 marker drops its entry (`ListPersonalizedMarker.tsx`); `list.rowNumbers` and `console.objectView.personalizedParts.rowNumbers` leave all 11 packs. Premise correction recorded on the claim: no stored personal row-number setting exists (it was session-only React state), so "刷新后也不显示" needs no migration.
- **The docs sentence on the marker** (`content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, claim amendment 3): it no longer lists row numbers among what the marker names.
- **A column diagnostic that became false** (`columnSpellingDiagnostics.ts`, claim amendment 2): a grid whose authored columns all fail to resolve "renders NO data columns", no longer "renders its row-number column and NO data columns".

## Tests

New:
- `ui/e2e/list-left-edge-35663.spec.ts` (Playwright). Real `ObjectGrid` + `data-table` + app-shell `PageHeader` (list posture), bundled by Vite from source, the view bar from `listToolbarRow.ts`'s own constants, the switcher's and the footer's classes read from their sources, real theme Tailwind. Cases: 1280 wide list (overflows), 1280 narrow list (fits), the wide list scrolled to the far right and back, and 375.

Migrated (the grid no longer has a `#` column by default):
- `plugin-grid`: `columnDeclaredSpellingOnly`, `columnSpellingDiagnosticRender`, `columnSpellingDiagnostics`, `gridColumnMembers-8071`, `gridDependentValues-7165`, `lookupPickerKeys-7154`, `relationalMetaCopySet-7166` (header lists lose `#`; data-cell indexes lose the +1), `rowColorTint-12375` (two sticky cells, not three; the leading cell's tint stays pinned in `data-table-row-tint-sticky-12375`), `rowHeightOffSpecBoundary` (opts into `showRowNumbers` so the table-level cell copy stays observable on the row-number cell), `serverSearch` (see Acceptance notes).
- `components`: `data-table-leadingCell-12423`, the "blank until hover" case reversed to "shown at rest".
- `plugin-list` (the switch is gone): `ListView.displayPopover-12423` (More carries Edit inline only; the "Row numbers is on by default" case becomes "the list hands the grid no row numbers, and no level offers a Row numbers switch"), `ListView.harness` (the displayMenuClose control flips Edit inline instead), `ListView.restoreViewDefaults-28948`, `ListView.toolbarIconButtons-12695`, `ListView.personalization-28950` (each used the switch as "a Display setting outside the stored preference"; now Edit inline, reported as `inlineEdit`), `ViewSettingsPopover.optionsMenu-35551` (More is offered through Edit inline), `ListViewBlock.compactRegion-12703` (the full list is "the grid was mounted", no longer "with row numbers").
- `plugin-list`, also: `ListView.permissions` (with Edit inline withheld and no drawer to choose, the menu now draws no More row at all; the two withheld cases assert that, each beside its control that opens More and finds the switch), `htmlTierColumnSpellings-6598` and `htmlTierListViewDefaultColumns-6598` (the authored headers no longer start with `#`).
- `app-shell`: `ObjectView.setupListChrome-12606`, the control becomes "the same list under another app draws no `#` column either"; `rowClickModifierPayloadForward-9462` (RED 2 opts its grid into `showRowNumbers`, since the hover "open record" button lives in the row-number cell; red on CI at e5c9c4e6).

Retired: `ListView.harness` › `ListView.setupChrome-12606` CONTROL ("without the prop the grid numbers its rows"); its prop is gone. The describe keeps one case: no list hands the grid row numbers, and Display still draws.

## Acceptance notes

docs/qa/platform-checklist items edited:
- **`records-forms.list-view-capabilities`** (rev 11 → 12): steps[11] and an acceptance clause for the left edge, the 40px selection column under a sideways scroll, no row numbers and the checkbox at rest, and ≥12 at 375. No earlier clause changed.

Readings (the e2e harness, main area 1024 wide beside a 256 sidebar at 1280; x from the main area's left):

| | page icon | view icon | select-all | row checkboxes | footer | selection column | row numbers | checkbox at rest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| main, wide (overflows) | 16 | 22 | 0 | 0 | 16 | 16 | 12 | opacity 0 |
| main, narrow (fits) | 16 | 22 | 38.9 | 38.9 | 16 | 93.9 | 12 | opacity 0 |
| this PR, wide | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 40 | 0 | opacity 1 |
| this PR, narrow | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 16 | 40 | 0 | opacity 1 |

- Scrolled to the far right and back: 40 / left 0 both legs (main: 16); no gap between frozen cells (0). First column's header text and cell text both at 52.
- Right edges: page bar 「新建」 box 16 in; view bar's last label 16 in (main: 24).
- 375: page icon 16, view icon 14, card content 21, footer 16 (unchanged from main; below 768 the grid draws cards).
- The main-branch readings reproduce the card's live readings (0 / 22 / 16 / 28 on the wide list).

Found on the way, not filed:
- `serverSearch.test.tsx` "reports the real match total" was green because the second row's NUMBER put a "2" in the text; a one-page grid draws no pager, so no total is on screen. Re-pointed to the rows on screen. class: none (a test read, no product defect).
- A non-selectable grid with a row click drew a hover 「打开 ›」 button inside its row-number cell (`data-table.tsx`, `row-expand-button`). With row numbers off by default, that button is drawn only where a host opts into row numbers; clicking the row still opens the record, and a Cmd/Ctrl-click on the row still forwards its modifiers (`rowClickModifierPayloadForward-9462` RED 1). carrier: none (follows from the card's "no row numbers").
- The chart view's own view bar copy (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx` ~355, `sm:px-4`) keeps the switcher icon at 22 there; it is outside this card's surface. carrier: none.

Screenshots (before / after, 1280 wide, narrow, scrolled, 375): `objectstack-seat5/area-ux/ux-4/list2/card-35663/` in the project files.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`: `LEADING_CELL_WIDTH` / `LEADING_CELL_INSET` on every leading cell, and the visibility arm now gated on `showRowNumbers`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: the `?? false` default.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` and `components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`: the row-number state, prop and part gone; `hasMore` without the switch.
4. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/listToolbarRow.ts`: `TOOLBAR_ROW`'s `sm:` padding.

Two-minute check: open any wide list (e.g. Contacts) at 1280 and scroll it sideways; the checkbox column keeps its width, 16px from the left, in line with the page bar icon. Open 「选项」 › 更多: no 行号 switch.

  - `TOOLBAR_ROW` `sm:pl-2.5 sm:pr-2` → `sm:px-4`: 2 red ("view-bar icon starts at 22, not 16").

A wider local run (all of app-shell, console, plugin-detail, plugin-view) did not finish inside the box's hour, so the full suite is CI's 16 shards at this head.
